Prof. M. S. Baghel Memorial Lecture Series

A lecture series to pay tribute and walk on the path of The great teacher of teachers-Prof.M.S.Baghel. This series will have twelve lectures on various topics of Ayurveda education, research and practice by eminent speakers. The lectures are intended to increase awareness about core potential of Ayurveda across the globe as envisioned by Prof. M.S. Baghel. Each lecture was delivered online on 9️th day of every month till 09 January 2022.

Souvenir based on Prof. M. S. Baghel Memorial Lecture Series

The Souvenir based on Prof.M.S.Baghel Memorial Lecture Series is published in the form of electronic book (ISBN: 978-81-948207-0-3).

The details are as below:

Foreword by :  Vaidya Rajesh Kotecha

Preface by :  Prof. Dr. Anup Thakar

Editorial by :  Dr. Gopal Basisht

The souvenir includes twelve articles based on lectures delivered by eminent speakers on important topics of principles of diagnosis and management in Ayurveda.

Distribution: Free

Contact: csrtsdc@gmail.com

Download link: Click Here To View/Download Souvenir based on Prof. M. S. Baghel Memorial Lecture Series

Ayurveda and Diabetes

As a part of National Ayurveda Day & World Diabetes Day celebrations Obesity-Diabetes Lab, IRSHA and Charak Samhita Centre , ITRA jointly organized a unique session on Ayurveda & Diabetes on November 23, 2020, 4.00 PM to 5.30 PM. The session featured Ayurveda experts and endocrinologists coming together to ponder upon better management solution for Diabetes. The detail program is available on our [1] .The talks are available on our YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yPB_9twQY_Q .

Wikipedia Editing

An interactive session on Wikipedia Editing was organized on September 05, 2020. Dr. Abhijeet Safai, Symbiosis University, Pune and 
Shri. Sudhanwa Jogalekar, Former President of Wikimedia, India delivered talks on the topic. The talks are available on our YouTube channel https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xeU4nOhrV1Q .

Talk Series on Health
